name: Mary Celeste
description: An American brigantine found drifting in good order but completely abandoned in the Atlantic east of the Azores on 4 December 1872; her ten-person company — Captain Benjamin Briggs, his wife and infant daughter, and seven crew — were never seen again.

aliases.name: Marie Celeste
aliases.meaning: Misspelling popularised by Arthur Conan Doyle's 1884 short story 'J. Habakuk Jephson's Statement'

aliases.name: Amazon
aliases.meaning: Original name of the brigantine before her 1868 sale and renaming

origin: The events occurred in the central North Atlantic, with the abandonment somewhere east of the Azores. The ship was found at approximately 38°20′N 17°15′W, midway between the Azores and the Portuguese coast.
